The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ec0e1bb240b41be6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. statement: Choose L sufficiently large and then δ sufficiently small. Under (4.1), h′ v,p ≤ Bs/8 + C∗ LB2s + o(s), (4.10) h′ v,2 ≤ Cη,LF∗s + ε∗Bs + o(s). (4.11) Here C∗ L grows at most polynomially in L. For the second inequality, assume that each output principal slot has diagonal second-moment bound sup σ E|h′ a(σ)|2 ≤ e−2v F2 ∗ s2 , F∗ ≥ 1. (4.12) A bound on its raw second tensor implies this hypothesis. One can choose ε∗ < [100(1 + C∗ L)]−1: first use the long-slot suppression, then choose the dictionary accuracy η and the mesh threshold r0. These choices do not depend on B, B2, F∗.
